skill.name: kuaishou-competitor-research
skill.description: Search Kuaishou videos by keyword through SocialDataX. Compare how competitors cover a topic using traceable examples and available engagement data.
skill.summary: Turn a Kuaishou video sample into a competitor content brief.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are Markdown syntax, field names, or documentation links. The workflow runs an unpinned CLI with access to configured credentials and does not specify safe argument passing or separate approval for paid searches. No evidence found of embedded secrets or instructions to disclose API keys.

remediation.issue: An unpinned npm package runs during authentication and search.
remediation.suggestion: Use an exact, reviewed CLI version with verified package integrity. Require user approval before any installation, and restrict the CLI to necessary credentials and permissions.

remediation.issue: The CLI reads environment credentials and can persist an API key in a local JSON file.
remediation.suggestion: Use an operating system credential store or managed secret provider. Limit credential scope, remove unused credential aliases, and keep secret values out of diagnostic output.

remediation.issue: The shell workflow does not specify safe handling for dynamic keywords and pagination tokens.
remediation.suggestion: Pass the keyword and cursor as separate arguments without shell interpretation, or use typed MCP parameters. Keep raw cursors out of reports and logs.

remediation.issue: The workflow does not require explicit cost approval before a paid search.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose possible charges and ask the user to approve a page or item limit before paid requests. Apply that limit to retries and continued pagination.

content.value_statement: Comparing competitors on Kuaishou takes time when examples are scattered across search results. Collect a focused video sample and compare content angles with links to the evidence.
actual_capabilities: Search Kuaishou videos by keyword through the SocialDataX CLI or a configured MCP connection.
Limit CLI collection by page count or item count and resume the same search when a cursor is available.
Record titles, authors, links or video IDs, and available publication dates and interaction metrics.
Group relevant samples by content angle and separate observations from interpretations.
Flag incomplete CLI results and retain collected items when a later page fails.
limitations: Requires an authenticated SocialDataX CLI or hosted MCP connection. Search requests may consume credits.
Search provides a sample, not a complete record of Kuaishou videos or competitors.
Reports use returned metadata. Some results may lack dates, links, or visible engagement figures.
Does not publish, interact with videos, or modify Kuaishou accounts.

use_cases.title: Benchmark product launch messaging
use_cases.description: Compare how competing brands introduce similar products and distinguish common claims from unusual approaches.

use_cases.title: Prepare a creator brief
use_cases.description: Group relevant videos by format and audience to build a brief with examples the team can review.

use_cases.title: Choose a topic to test
use_cases.description: Review examples in a niche and identify a content angle to test without assuming it will outperform alternatives.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Page of Results
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Get an initial sample for a single topic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Kuaishou for [topic] and stop after one page. Give me the most relevant titles, authors, and links or video IDs.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Content Angles
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Compare how two brands cover the same category.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [brand A] and [brand B] in [category], one page per brand. Group relevant samples by angle and cite a video for each comparison.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Evidence-Based Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Compare examples before choosing a video format.
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect up to [item limit] Kuaishou videos about [topic]. Compare formats, audience cues, and available interactions. Separate observed facts from recommendations and cite each example.

prompt_templates.title: Track a Bounded Research Sample
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Manage a multi-page review with comparable evidence and a clear stopping point.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [keywords] using up to [page limit] pages per query. Ask before any paid calls. Preserve links or IDs, list missing metrics, and report incomplete results without restarting the search.

output_examples.input: Show a one-page sample of Kuaishou videos about portable blenders.
output: Illustrative result: Two videos were relevant. Sample video A shows cleanup. Sample video B compares recipes.
Interpretation: The samples emphasize convenience and versatility. This page does not establish which angle performs better.

output_examples.input: Compare Kuaishou coverage of two sunscreen brands and flag any missing data.
output: Illustrative result: Brand A uses a texture demonstration. Brand B shows application during an outdoor routine.
Evidence limit: Brand B's search stopped after the first page. One item lacks interaction counts, so the samples cannot support an engagement comparison.
Next step: Check more examples before deciding whether these angles are common for either brand.

best_practices: Start with a focused keyword and one page. Agree on the limit and any credit use before expanding the search.
Record video IDs or links and separate visible evidence from your interpretation.
Report missing metrics or incomplete pages before comparing results.
anti_patterns: Treating search results as a complete set of competitor videos.
Treating engagement counts as proof that a format caused better performance.
Pasting API keys into chat or including pagination tokens in shared reports.

faq.question: What can I search for?
faq.answer: Use a keyword or topic. Add a brand, audience, or use case to narrow the search.

faq.question: What access do I need?
faq.answer: Use an authenticated SocialDataX CLI or an already authenticated MCP connection. MCP does not require a separate local CLI key.

faq.question: Can searches use credits?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI credential status check does not call paid endpoints, but searches may consume SocialDataX credits.

faq.question: Can this review cover every matching video?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable boundary for a complete result set. Choose a page or item limit and treat the output as a sample.

faq.question: What happens when a later page fails?
faq.answer: The CLI can keep collected results and mark them incomplete. Resume from a returned cursor only when it is available and the original limit allows it.

faq.question: Can the skill post or interact on Kuaishou?
faq.answer: No. The documented Kuaishou workflow is limited to searching and analyzing returned video information.
